what: On the canvas, 120 strands in four colors cross the screen tilted 12°, waving with two layered cosines (amplitude 10~45px, frequency .001~.0084, speed .006~.007, second layer 1.5× frequency, opposite direction, .3× amplitude). Each strand is re-sorted front to back by depth so they look twisted, and the bundle width breathes 1.0~2.2× following sin(t·.005). Color mass ratio: sky 26, blue 10, pink 22, yellow 36

options.y: Bundle center height (element height multiples), default .5
options.band: Lower further from the center (rem), default 0
options.speed: Time step per frame, default 1 — 0 means a still image
options.--fx-thread-1~4: Four thread colors (css variables) — by default --kf-accent-soft, --kf-accent and a pink and yellow rotated from the accent color

use:
…

— The canvas covers the element, with text on top

from.where: shared.js ST.threads — Hero colored-thread bundle (original kv inline canvas)·menu left panel

note: Runs only when visible on screen (IntersectionObserver). In reduced-motion mode it draws a single scene. When the skin (data-theme, class) changes, the thread color is re-read
